bugClass: overflow to Infinity -> NaN (missing finite guard on a multiplication)
bugSummary: For very large inputs, milliseconds * 1e6 (and * 1000) overflows to Infinity, and Math.trunc(Infinity % 1000) is NaN, so the microseconds and nanoseconds fields come back as NaN instead of finite values; the fix coerces a non-finite intermediate to 0.
triggerInput: parseMilliseconds(Number.MAX_VALUE) returns microseconds:NaN, nanoseconds:NaN in the buggy version; correct returns 0 for both. (Requires a near-MAX_VALUE input; ~1e300 does not yet trigger it.)
